scope: Project survey reporting, technician filtering and subject presentation
behavior: Response pages and negative feedback retain ticket/project identity and tenant-scoped assigned agent names.
Technician filtering matches either subject type; filter options require a tenant-owned user rather than exposing a dangling foreign agent ID.
Recent-response links target project or ticket routes; negative feedback, response details and print reports show the correct subject.
New labels are supplied in all eight supported languages.
limits: Database behavior uses actual query execution in transaction-owned schemas; authenticated filter context is substituted.
UI tests render real report components in jsdom; locale hook and dialog shell are substituted. No browser end-to-end claim.
Unused legacy server copies of analytics service/types remain unchanged; the active package action path imports the updated package service.
